title: Screwball by Chubby Treatz | 60ml Longfill
description:
Screwball Longfill E-Liquid:
Indulge in the nostalgia of a classic summer treat with Screwball Longfill E-Liquid. This deliciously crafted blend combines the smooth creaminess of vanilla ice cream with the bright, tangy sweetness of raspberry syrup. To top it all off, a playful bubblegum finish rounds out the flavour, making it a perfect blend for those who crave dessert-inspired e-liquids. Experience the joy of a timeless screwball treat in a bottle, all without chasing down the ice cream truck!
What is a Longfill E-Liquid?
Are you in search of higher nicotine strengths in a larger bottle? Longfill E-Liquids might be for you! What exactly is a 60ml Longfill? It’s a 60ml bottle that includes 30ml of flavour concentrate (in your choice of 50VG/50PG or 70VG/30PG), allowing for customisation of nicotine strengths. These are paired with the correct set of 10ml nicotine boosters to create your desired strength.
How to use:
First, choose your preferred nicotine strength and ratio. We recommend 70/30 for higher-powered sub-ohm devices, and 50/50 for smaller MTL/pod kit devices.
Next, add the provided ingredients – nicotine and/or booster shots – into the 60ml Longfill bottle.
Finally, shake well, leave to stand for a few minutes, and it’s ready for you to enjoy.
Please note:
Longfills are not ready to use and require mixing before use. For more details, visit our Simplified Guide To Longfills.
Product Features:
Brand:
Chubby Treatz
Product Origin:
UK
Product Type:
Longfill E-Liquid.
Bottle Size:
Supplied in a 60ml bottle containing 20ml of concentrated E-Liquid, leaving space for 4 x 10ml bottles (Included with your purchase if selected), to make 60ml of flavoured e-liquid in a strength of your choice.
Nicotine Strength:
Regular Nicotine (3mg, 6mg, 12mg) and Nic Salt (3mg, 6mg, 10mg & 14mg)
Juice Mix:
The 3mg Freebase and Nic Salt kits mix to 70% VG / 30% PG. The remaining kits mix to 50% VG / 50% PG, perfect for smaller MTL devices/pod kits.
